task: Take the BOX_MIDDLE of the box and place it on INSPECTION_TABLE. After that, the stack should look like it is removed the middle box ONLY. NOTE: only the top box of the box stack can be picked(like the data structure).
plan_summary: Remove BOX_MIDDLE from the stack by first moving BOX_TOP to TEMP_TABLE, then moving BOX_MIDDLE to INSPECTION_TABLE, and finally placing BOX_TOP back on BOX_BOTTOM to restore the stack without the middle box.
assumptions: BOX_TOP is the topmost box and can be picked first.
TEMP_TABLE is used as temporary storage for BOX_TOP.
After completion, the stack will be BOX_BOTTOM with BOX_TOP on it, and BOX_MIDDLE will be on INSPECTION_TABLE.
Navigation tolerance of 0.5 is sufficient to be within interaction distance of 2.0.
